evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Improve data quality and trust through testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, and clear ownership.
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour — testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, governance and 'consistent, reliable numbers' recur across both responsibilities and requirements, outnumbering the pace signals by more than two to one.
evidence.domain_risk: turn Blinq's growing data into trusted, decision-ready insight across Product, Growth, Revenue, and Operations
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate — errors affect internal product and commercial decisions at a SaaS company, with no financial reporting, audit or regulatory consequence named.
evidence.collaboration_width: Product; Growth; Revenue; Operations; Finance; Engineering
evidence.data_team_maturity: Raise the bar for how Blinq uses data by improving standards, tooling, and analytics practices as the company scales.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mid — an analytics layer, warehouse and dbt already exist and the role evolves them, but standards and practices are still being raised rather than operating at specialised scale.
evidence.jd_authorship: Support product analytics and experimentation, including funnel analysis, cohorts, retention, activation, monetisation, and A/B testing.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: hiring_manager — the bullets name specific analytical methods, the transformation stack and the instrumentation work, so the day-to-day is legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Product, Growth, Revenue, Finance, and Engineering to translate ambiguous questions into clear metrics, analysis, and data products.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Mixed — product analytics and experimentation carry equal weight to revenue and monetisation work, and the JD asks explicitly for 'strong product and commercial instincts'.
evidence.autonomy_level: Own and evolve Blinq's analytics layer, building clean, reusable data models that turn raw product and business data into trusted datasets.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic — the candidate owns the analytics layer, defines the canonical metrics and raises company-wide analytics standards.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: None — Blinq describes itself as an AI-native company but no responsibility or requirement asks the candidate to use or enable AI; the only other AI mention concerns the hiring process.
evidence.testing_framing: Improve data quality and trust through testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, and clear ownership.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility — testing and data quality are framed as an owned improvement mandate with explicit ownership, not as tools in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: ensure decisions are grounded in consistent, reliable numbers
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: High — trust in the numbers appears in the role summary and recurs through 'trusted datasets', 'consistent definitions' and 'data quality and trust' as the role's core justification.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Own and evolve Blinq's analytics layer ... Build and maintain scalable ELT workflows using SQL, dbt, and modern cloud data tools.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Mixed — building new models, metrics and self-serve foundations sits alongside evolving the existing analytics layer and improving instrumentation and data quality.
evidence.work_arrangement: This is a hybrid role based in Melbourne or Sydney. ... Three days a week in the office, two wherever works for you.
evidence.loss_aversion: 'Define canonical metrics and semantic models so teams work from consistent definitions across dashboards and decision-making' — the fear is teams making decisions off divergent numbers.

responsibilities: Own and evolve Blinq's analytics layer, building clean, reusable data models that turn raw product and business data into trusted datasets.
Partner with Product, Growth, Revenue, Finance, and Engineering to translate ambiguous questions into clear metrics, analysis, and data products.
Build and maintain scalable ELT workflows using SQL, dbt, and modern cloud data tools.
Define canonical metrics and semantic models so teams work from consistent definitions across dashboards and decision-making.
Develop high-quality dashboards and self-serve reporting that help teams move quickly without relying on one-off analysis.
Support product analytics and experimentation, including funnel analysis, cohorts, retention, activation, monetisation, and A/B testing.
Improve data quality and trust through testing, documentation, lineage, monitoring, and clear ownership.
Investigate complex questions, surface the “why” behind performance, and turn insights into practical recommendations.
Work with data and software engineers to improve instrumentation, event tracking, and the reliability of data flowing from source systems.
Raise the bar for how Blinq uses data by improving standards, tooling, and analytics practices as the company scales.
